title: Riyâzüs-Sâlihîn (Turkish translation, DİB)
author: al-Nawawī (tr. M. Emin Özafşar, Bünyamin Erul)
coverage: 3 volumes, all pages with a readable text layer
edition: Riyâzüs-Sâlihîn, Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı Yayınları, Ankara 2015 (3 cilt), tr. Prof. Dr. M. Emin Özafşar and Prof. Dr. Bünyamin Erul; foreword Mehmet Görmez; replaces the Hasan Hüsnü Erdem / Kıvamüddin Burslan translation. Scan uploaded to archive.org by 'Lami Aydın' (2024-07-30).
licence: copyrighted DİB publication; third-party upload on archive.org, no licence stated; local research copy only, not redistributed (segments git-ignored)
notes: OCR (Tesseract -l Arabic+tur) is partial: garbled on framed/Arabic pages, most hadith numbers lost; chapter titles are DİB's own regrouping, not al-Nawawī's; verses are in footnotes («Hûd, 11/3»), their translations from the Diyanet meal. Use for Turkish search, not for exact alignment. OCR repair (ocr_fix.py): only certain corrections, originals kept in text_ocr/ocr_fixes; see ingestion.ocr_corrections.

ingestion.method: archive.org OCR text layer split at the page footers
ingestion.quality: partial OCR (see notes); not aligned to RIYAD hadith numbers except where the number is readable

rules.header: running page/volume headers left inside the text removed (per-source patterns)
rules.noise: leftover Arabic-noise punctuation runs (3+ commas/semicolons in a row) removed
rules.hyphen: hyphenation leftover 'xx- yy' joined when the joined word is attested in the clean meals
rules.join: letter-spaced / split words joined when the joined form is attested and the spaced sequence never occurs in the clean meals
rules.sub: non-word turned into an attested word by one known OCR confusion (rı->n, ı->r, fi->â, ...) with a clear winner
rules.case: stray capital inside a word lower-cased when the lower-cased form is attested

ocr_corrections.original: each changed segment keeps its imported text in text_ocr (notes_ocr) and the list ocr_fixes
